'''Gobuch''' is the capital and political-administrative hub of the [[Union of Zhensanov]]. The [[Nogoyevian War of Independence]] source identifies it as the center from which Zhensanov enforced centralized policy across the Union's constituent nations.

This draft is a minimal bridge page. Gobuch needs map confirmation and a fuller national-history article before publication as a polished AGGSWorld wiki page.
